name: steamworks
description: Release assistant for Steam games: finds what your project has, asks you the rest, writes and checks the store page, achievements and settings against Valve's rules, and fills Steamworks only after you approve. Never publishes.

games_folder.title: Games folder
games_folder.description: The folder that holds your game projects. Leave empty to use the folder Claude Code runs in.

publisher_key.title: Steamworks publisher Web API key (optional)
publisher_key.description: Only for builds, beta branches and leaderboards. Leave empty if you don't have one.
